notes.title: Final Update
notes.content: [p]This was my first ever game and to be honest you can tell. While this is the end of this game's life. [/p][p]The Home: Into The Woods, will be a remastered version with multiplayer support. [/p][p]Coming soon for free along with a new project The Home: Recollections and of course The Home: Full Game.[/p][p][/p][p]A launcher will be made public and the dlcs for THITW and THR will be free. I hope to make the full game free but we will have to see.[/p][p]Keep an eye out, because these games are far better than this game ever was.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you everyone for your support. And shout out to Annoying Crow don't worry the new Into The Woods will have more than one tree. And you might have a small cameo in THR.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks,[/p][p]James C Inviv[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45179841/ba44eea51a1c9b8140be433a02c158c461d91287.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45179841/5d0f11a1d430e6a943246ed78f6ade01f1aa11d0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45179841/610dc13bfc4095192d9cab6c63f7f976489ba1c6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45179841/94624daa57295ba50ef4e2cbd33bcf9da2c371b6.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The Home Into The Woods Update v2.0!
notes.content:
On the 8th of December update v2.0 will be made public! It will still be free to play so don't worry. I have made quite a lot of changes to the game, based on suggestions I have received. I want to thank every one who has played it and who has supported the GoFundMe. I hope you enjoy the update when it comes out.

Thank you!

Added:
A new ending
Map graphic has trees
Fixed bugs
Much more
